data.title: 爱西亚 · 教堂庭院的雏菊采摘
data.description: 绿草如茵的教堂庭院内野花盛开。爱西亚轻柔地采摘下一朵嫩黄雏菊，微红着小脸踮起脚尖，小心翼翼地别在你胸前的口袋上，翠绿的双眸盛满了羞涩与幸福。
data.location: sunlit church courtyard lawn with blooming wildflowers
data.action: kneeling on green lawn picking daisies, blushing sweetly as she places a wildflower into partner breast pocket with trembling tender fingers
data.lighting: warm peaceful afternoon sunshine filtering through chapel trees
data.mood: angelic innocence, pastoral tranquility, shy pure-hearted devotion
data.promptProse: In a sunlit church garden, Asia Argento blushes sweetly as she gently places a fresh daisy into partner pocket with tender green eyes.
data.animaCaption: Asia Argento placing a daisy into partner pocket in church garden.
